svg.title: Tears of Steel: dialogue and descriptions
svg.desc: 46 descriptions, 172 seconds of narration, each placed between lines of dialogue.
svg.text: Tears of Steel: where aloud speaks
46 descriptions, 2.9 minutes of narration. Dialogue as the film's own production stems hear it.
